long_biography.plain_text:
Patricia B. Dean bought the naming rights to Roger Dean Stadium in Jupiter in 1998 to honour her father, the car dealer Roger Houston Dean. The agreement linked the family’s name with a baseball venue used by the Miami Marlins and St Louis Cardinals.

Dean and Mike Maroone subsequently became joint owners and managers of the West Palm Beach Chevrolet dealership. In 2020, Dean sold him her remaining shares, but retained the stadium naming rights. The ballpark’s commercial partnership then shifted to promoting the family’s Chevrolet dealership in Cape Coral.
long_biography.html:
Patricia B. Dean bought the naming rights to Roger Dean Stadium in Jupiter in 1998 to honour her father, the car dealer Roger Houston Dean. The agreement linked the family’s name with a baseball venue used by the Miami Marlins and St Louis Cardinals.

Dean and Mike Maroone subsequently became joint owners and managers of the West Palm Beach Chevrolet dealership. In 2020, Dean sold him her remaining shares, but retained the stadium naming rights. The ballpark’s commercial partnership then shifted to promoting the family’s Chevrolet dealership in Cape Coral.
